title: MLLMs Know When Before Speaking: Revealing and Recovering Temporal Grounding via Attention Cues

task_scope.task_family: video moment retrieval / video temporal grounding
task_scope.why_in_or_out: The task explicitly localizes query-relevant temporal moments or highlights.

evidence.quote: # Abstract Video temporal grounding (VTG), which localizes the start and end times of a queried event in an untrimmed video, is a key test of whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) understand not only what happens but also when it happens.

background_setup.summary: # Introduction Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become remarkably capable video understanders , yet a simple follow-up question often trips them up: when does it happen?
